00001| # Issue 712 case study — tool intent as semantic frames
00002| 
00003| Issue [#712](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/issues/712) reported a
00004| routing matrix in v0.289.0: tools were advertised by the client, but small
00005| wording changes prevented URL fetch, web search, file edit, and declarative file
00006| write calls. The maintainer's follow-up on
00007| [PR #719](https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/pull/719#issuecomment-4982573187)
00008| rejected an initial phrase-by-phrase patch and required a deeper solution aligned
00009| with the vision, roadmap, associative auto-learning, and Formal AI via Agent CLI.
00010| 
00011| ## Reproduction
00012| 
00013| `tests/issue_712.rs` preserves every failing prompt from the issue. The first
00014| pre-fix run is in [`red-regression.log`](red-regression.log). The suite also
00015| contains paraphrases that were not in the report; these prevent the implementation
00016| from passing by memorizing the issue sentences. `tests/integration/issue_712_intent_routing.rs`
00017| boots the real server and verifies Chat Completions, Responses, and Gemini.
00018| 
00019| The original self-coding sessions are preserved in the three `agent-*.jsonl`
00020| files in this directory. The current implementation adds a second, independent
00021| Agent CLI task: Formal AI ingests the persisted routing observations through the
00022| associative-memory adapter, ranks observations and semantic amendments, writes
00023| `tool-routing-learning-report.lino`, verifies it, and leaves promotion explicitly
00024| `awaiting_human_review`. The runner is
00025| [`experiments/agent_cli_e2e/run_issue_712_learning.sh`](../../../experiments/agent_cli_e2e/run_issue_712_learning.sh).
00026| Its checked-in evidence includes the
00027| [`Agent CLI event stream`](agent-cli-routing-learning/agent-stream.jsonl),
00028| [`classified diagnostics`](agent-cli-routing-learning/agent-stderr.log), and the
00029| [`derived learning report`](agent-cli-routing-learning/tool-routing-learning-report.lino).
00030| 
00031| ## Root cause and architecture
00032| 
00033| The problem was a mismatch between semantic knowledge and executable argument
00034| shape, not four missing aliases. See [`root-cause.md`](root-cause.md) for the
00035| traced paths and [`requirements.md`](requirements.md) for the full contract.
00036| 
00037| The resulting routing model is:
00038| 
00039| | Capability | Seed-defined semantic evidence | Typed argument evidence |
00040| | --- | --- | --- |
00041| | Fetch | HTTP-fetch or URL-navigation action | one normalized HTTP(S) URL |
00042| | Search | search action, or source-grounded/current-source frame | non-empty topic extracted through a topic connective or imperative slot |
00043| | Edit | edit action | safe file target plus old/new replacement spans |
00044| | Write | write action/target/content roles | safe file target plus non-empty literal payload |
00045| 
00046| Natural-language surfaces remain in `data/seed`, including `google` as a search
00047| action and `contents` as a write-content lead. Rust and the browser worker apply
00048| the same structural algorithms in `web_search_intent.rs` and the worker modules
00049| `formal_ai_worker_16.js` / `formal_ai_worker_17.js`. The three reported search
00050| sentences are no longer explicit templates. File-write classification now calls
00051| the exact parser that composes the executable write plan, eliminating a separate
00052| English/Russian verb gate that could disagree with execution.
00053| 
00054| ## Auto-learning boundary
00055| 
00056| `data/meta/issue-712-routing-learning.lino` is an append-only observation and
00057| amendment network. `agentic_coding::routing_learning` passes it through the
00058| production `AssociativeMemory` pipeline, preserving evidence links and ranking
00059| expressions by reads, writes, incoming links, and outgoing links. Its output is a
00060| review artifact, not an automatic seed mutation. Promotion is gated on both the
00061| reported matrix and unseen-paraphrase benchmark. This uses learning to retain and
00062| prioritize a reusable rule—seed roles plus argument shape—without allowing a
00063| single incident to silently rewrite routing policy.
00064| 
00065| ## Verification evidence
00066| 
00067| - `tests/issue_712.rs`: reported matrix, unseen search paraphrases, multilingual
00068|   write frames, and a `webhook` boundary negative.
00069| - `tests/integration/issue_712_intent_routing.rs`: production HTTP surfaces and
00070|   the whole capability matrix.
00071| - `tests/unit/issue_712_routing_learning.rs`: derived (not canned) associative
00072|   ranking, human-review gate, and in-repo three-turn Agent CLI execution.
00073| - `.github/workflows/release.yml`: real external Agent CLI declarative-write E2E.
00074| - [`green-regression.log`](green-regression.log) and
00075|   [`live-agent-cli-e2e.log`](live-agent-cli-e2e.log): original local evidence.
00076| - [`agent-cli-routing-learning/tool-routing-learning-report.lino`](agent-cli-routing-learning/tool-routing-learning-report.lino):
00077|   external Agent CLI result derived from six linked observations and amendments,
00078|   with promotion still awaiting human review.
00079| 
00080| No new dependency is introduced. The fix composes the seed lexicon, existing
00081| intent router, general planner, associative persistence, and document recipe.
00082|
